# bun audit high-severity allowlist
#
# `.github/workflows/ci.yml`'s `audit` job runs:
#   bun audit --audit-level=high $(this file, one --ignore=<GHSA-id> per line)
# Any HIGH or CRITICAL advisory NOT listed below fails CI immediately.
#
# Every line here is a temporary, individually-justified exception for a
# finding that existed on the date it was added — not a blanket suppression.
# Do NOT add an entry without a justification, and do NOT bump the date on
# review without re-verifying the reasoning still holds.
#
# Review cadence: re-audit and prune stale entries whenever a listed
# package is intentionally upgraded, and at least quarterly otherwise.
# Follow-up tracking issue: https://github.com/rhonda-rodododo/llamenos-platform/issues/649
#
# Format: GHSA-id  # added YYYY-MM-DD by <who> — package — reachability — reasoning

# --- h3 / smol-toml / js-yaml / svgo: astro (marketing site build, site/) ---
# All four are pulled in transitively by Astro, used only to build the static
# marketing site (`site/`) deployed to Cloudflare Pages. None of these code
# paths (Astro dev server, SSE, TOML config parsing, SVG optimization) ship
# in the final static HTML/CSS/JS output or run against untrusted input at
# request time in the deployed site.
GHSA-22cc-p3c6-wpvm  # added 2026-09-11 by rhonda-rodododo — h3 (astro, site/ build tool) — build-time only, not present in static output
GHSA-7w5x-hrqm-74c2  # added 2026-09-11 by rhonda-rodododo — smol-toml (astro, site/ build tool) — parses only repo-controlled TOML at build time
GHSA-52cp-r559-cp3m  # added 2026-09-11 by rhonda-rodododo — js-yaml (astro, site/ build tool) — parses only repo-controlled YAML at build time
GHSA-5p4m-2wfm-xmqj  # added 2026-09-11 by rhonda-rodododo — js-yaml (astro, site/ build tool) — same as above
GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh  # added 2026-09-11 by rhonda-rodododo — js-yaml (astro, site/ build tool) — same as above
GHSA-2p49-hgcm-8545  # added 2026-09-11 by rhonda-rodododo — svgo (astro, site/ build tool) — optimizes repo-controlled SVG assets at build time only
GHSA-w27v-7q3p-w38r  # added 2026-09-11 by rhonda-rodododo — svgo (astro, site/ build tool) — same as above

# --- vite: direct devDependency, dev server only ---
# All four advisories are exploitable only against a running `vite dev`
# server (fs.deny bypass, dev-server websocket arbitrary file read). CI and
# production never run the Vite dev server — CI builds via `vite build` and
# serves the static output with `vite preview`; production serves the
# prebuilt bundle from the Tauri shell / static hosting. Still tracked for
# upgrade since local `bun run dev` does run the dev server.
GHSA-v2wj-q39q-566r  # added 2026-09-11 by rhonda-rodododo — vite (direct dep) — dev-server-only bypass, not exercised by build/preview
GHSA-p9ff-h696-f583  # added 2026-09-11 by rhonda-rodododo — vite (direct dep) — dev-server-only websocket file read
GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff  # added 2026-09-11 by rhonda-rodododo — vite (direct dep) — dev-server-only, Windows-path specific (Linux/macOS dev + CI unaffected)

# --- hono: direct production dependency (backend framework) ---
# This is the one entry in this list that IS in the production request path
# (apps/worker's Hono app). The advisory is in Hono's CORS middleware
# reflecting Origin with credentials when `origin` defaults to the
# wildcard. Audited apps/worker/app.ts: our CORS middleware always passes an
# explicit allow-list `origin` function (never the wildcard default), so the
# vulnerable default is not in use — but this is a config-dependent
# mitigation, not a code fix, so it stays allowlisted only until upgraded to
# a patched Hono release rather than being treated as permanently safe.
GHSA-88fw-hqm2-52qc  # added 2026-09-11 by rhonda-rodododo — hono (direct prod dep) — CORS wildcard default not used; explicit allow-list configured in apps/worker/app.ts; upgrade tracked

# --- form-data: openai (prod dep) / twilio (devDep, unused SDK path) ---
GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx  # added 2026-09-11 by rhonda-rodododo — form-data (via openai, prod dep; also via twilio devDep) — field/filenames we send to the OpenAI SDK are server-generated, not attacker-controlled; twilio path is devDependency-only and its SDK is not imported anywhere in apps/worker (adapters use raw fetch, see apps/worker/telephony/twilio.ts)

# --- axios: twilio (devDependency, SDK not imported at runtime) ---
GHSA-gcfj-64vw-6mp9  # added 2026-09-11 by rhonda-rodododo — axios (via twilio, devDependency) — twilio npm SDK is not imported by apps/worker (adapter uses safeFetch directly); no production reachability

# --- protobufjs: onnxruntime-web, used by client-side Whisper transcription ---
GHSA-wcpc-wj8m-hjx6  # added 2026-09-11 by rhonda-rodododo — protobufjs (via @huggingface/transformers > onnxruntime-web, prod dep) — parses only the bundled, repo-controlled ONNX model files shipped with the app, never user-supplied protobuf input
